name: Sorafenib (single-agent oral multikinase inhibitor)

biomarkers.note: No predictive biomarker gates sorafenib in HCC. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hepatocellular Carcinoma v2.2026, Principles of Biomarker Testing (HCC-J), molecular testing (MSI/dMMR, RET fusion, NTRK fusion) is used to identify subsequent-line targeted or immunotherapy options, not to select the first-line multikinase inhibitor backbone.

lineOfTherapy: first-line systemic therapy for advanced or unresectable HCC (category 1, Other Recommended); also usable in subsequent-line if not previously used

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: preserved liver function (Child-Pugh A). Full 400 mg twice-daily dosing is supported for serum bilirubin at or below 1.5x ULN; the pivotal SHARP and Asia-Pacific studies were limited to patients with preserved liver function.
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Ch. 36 Cancer of the Liver
eligibilityCriteria.locator: lines 111720 to 111732 (preserved liver function; full dose 400 mg twice daily for bilirubin <=1.5x ULN)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: therapies may have limited safety data for Child-Pugh class B or C; use with extreme caution in patients with elevated bilirubin.
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2), footnotes c and d; Principles of Liver Functional Assessment (HCC-E)

drugs.name: Sorafenib

provenance.locator: line 111732 (Ch. 36 Cancer of the Liver: sorafenib at the full dose of 400 mg twice daily for bilirubin <=1.5x ULN)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 36, line 111732. Sorafenib 400 mg PO TWICE DAILY (BID), total 800 mg/day, taken continuously (represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day continuous-dosing accounting cycle; there is no discrete drug-free interval). The Standard Guidelines (NCCN) HCC v2.2026 adjuvant STORM description also cites sorafenib 800 mg daily (hcc.txt line 2314). Hepatic-impairment dose adjustment per DeVita line 111732: for bilirubin 1.6 to 3x ULN consider half dose; for albumin <2.5 g/dL no more than 200 mg once daily (source DeVita prints mg/dL in error; albumin is measured in g/dL); no safe dose established for bilirubin >3x ULN.

supportiveCare: Hand-foot skin reaction: monitor and manage; dose-modify per labeling (TKI class effect).
Liver function monitoring; hepatic-impairment dose adjustment per DeVita line 111732.

monitoring: Blood pressure at baseline and during therapy (VEGF-pathway TKI)
Liver function tests (bilirubin-based dose adjustment applies)

doseModificationRules.text: Consider half the full dose per DeVita line 111732; obtain clinical review.
No more than 200 mg once daily per DeVita line 111732; obtain clinical review.
No safe dose established per DeVita line 111732; clinical review required.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Ch. 36 Cancer of the Liver, line 111732 (sorafenib 400 mg twice daily; hepatic-impairment adjustments lines 111732 to 111737); preserved-liver-function eligibility lines 111720 to 111721

guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2): Sorafenib listed as a category 1 first-line Other Recommended regimen; caution footnotes c and d re Child-Pugh class; adjuvant STORM 800 mg daily context (hcc.txt line 2314). The guideline lists the regimen by name and does not print a per-mg dose; the dose is grounded to the DeVita core layer.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent sorafenib in advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (#22). The dose (400 mg PO twice daily, total 800 mg/day, continuous) is grounded to DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 36 Cancer of the Liver (line 111732), with the Standard Guidelines (NCCN) HCC v2.2026 Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2) supplying the setting, line, and category-1 status (the guideline lists the regimen by name and prints no per-mg dose). Continuous oral dosing is modeled as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day accounting cycle with cycles null (until progression); this is an administrative representation of continuous daily dosing, not a discrete cycle claim. Eligibility captures preserved liver function (Child-Pugh A) per DeVita lines 111720 to 111721 and the HCC-I caution footnotes for Child-Pugh B/C. Hepatic-impairment dose adjustments are carried in doseModificationRules per DeVita line 111732. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
